main_text.p: dæ isti artolatriæ, pro basi subiecit. Quis enim sentiat, pestilentissimum verbi diuini hostem, Christi verba in hoc honoris fastigium euehere, vt his tanta vis & potentia conuertendi pa-nem in corpus ipsius tribuatur? Siquidem nemo pius dubitat quin Christus quod se velle dixerit, praestare possit. Cùm igitur panem & vinum corpꝰ & sanguinem suum esse disertè affirmet, nisi quis Dominum vel mendacij vel imbecillitatis velit arguere, concedat oportet, Christum in cœna & vera dicere & praestare quæ dicit posse. Hæc tam plausibilia quem non in errorem illiciant?

Sciendum est autem, Satanam cum ministris suis pseudoprophetis & pseudapostolis, ad idololatriam stabiliendam, & seducedos miseros mortales, magnificè verbum Dei efferre & allegare: non quòd illi fides & obedientia verbo Dei adhibita, fit curæ: sed quò facilius in suos casses nos pertrahat[?], non prohibet, sed instigat, vt è verbis Christi

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. "pertrahat" is uncertain: the scan is blurred at that word. "seducedos" is kept as printed. The superscript after "corp" is read as the -us abbreviation (ꝰ). No marginal notes are printed on this page; the strip at the right edge is show-through or the neighbouring page and is left out.
